cases.description: A kind='venue' crawl target single-mapped to Casa da Cultura de Pernambuco. The handle is actually Pernambuco's statewide culture-department grants-bulletin account. 10 of 14 live events carry empty location_text (not checkable); of the 4 that do not, two name a real, different, specific place in plain prose that evaluate_attribution_dispute cannot see (METHOD_NAME_MATCH excluded from DISPUTE_METHODS). 12 of 14 are status=accepted in production -- live, served, wrong.

cases.description: A kind='venue' crawl target single-mapped to Theater Luis Mendonca. 9 of 10 live events' location_text are a spelling/transliteration variant of the venue's own name. The one exception, 'Teatro Nacional', already carries review_reason=sources_disagree via an unrelated existing mechanism and sits in pending_review -- confirmed benign, no live misattribution. Included here as a negative control: this handle must NOT be flagged.

cases.description: A kind='venue' crawl target single-mapped to BeerDock Boa Viagem. 16 of a real, larger live set of events already carry venue_id='beerdock_casa_forte' -- a DIFFERENT, specific venue, correctly reattributed hours earlier by plans/260912_events-venue-night-duplication.md's own backfill (neighbourhood_match) -- and must not count as non-corroborating evidence against the ORIGINAL mapping. One further real, distinct, genuinely still-unresolved event ('Mirante do Paco, Recife') stays below the pattern bar of 2 alone. Running the shipped tool against production for the first time (2026-09-13/14) re-flagged this handle at 17/46 before this fix; this is a representative subset (17 of the real 46), not the full set, sufficient to prove the fix without fabricating unfetched location_text values for the remaining ~29.
